description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter implementation named QuickSharingPermissionsAdapter, which manages and displays a list of QuickPermissionModel items in a RecyclerView. It includes view holder logic, binding data to views, handling theme/branding via BrandingUtil, and managing permission change interactions.

classes.name: QuickSharingPermissionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying quick sharing permissions in a RecyclerView, with branding and permission change handling.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ViewHolder, inflating the item layout and applying branding colors.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from quickPermissionList to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of permission items.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Updates the adapter's branding color and refreshes the displayed list.

inner_classes.name: QuickSharingPermissionViewHolder
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder that binds individual QuickPermissionModel data to item views, handling click interactions for permission toggling.

methods.name: bindData
methods.description: Binds a QuickPermissionModel to the view, setting text, visibility, and click listeners.

interfaces.name: OnPermissionChangeListener
interfaces.description: Interface for callbacks on permission change or dismiss.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates view, applies branding, returns ViewHolder.

methods.description: Sets branding color and updates list.
